tools.name: list_leads
tools.description: List saved leads for the authenticated user. Supports pagination and search by name, email, or company.

tools.name: search_leads
tools.description: Start an AI-powered lead search job. Returns a jobId immediately — poll get_search_job_status for results. Consumes search credits.

tools.name: get_search_job_status
tools.description: Poll the status and results of a lead search job.

tools.name: submit_lead_feedback
tools.description: Submit positive or negative feedback on an AI-generated lead message to improve future output quality.

tools.name: discover_companies
tools.description: Discover companies matching criteria via Hunter.io. Optionally fetch contact emails for each company.

tools.name: enrich_lead
tools.description: Enrich a lead with person and company data (seniority, department, LinkedIn, phone, company size, industry). Consumes enrichment credits.

tools.name: verify_emails
tools.description: Verify email deliverability for one or more email addresses. Consumes verification credits.

tools.name: score_leads
tools.description: Trigger on-demand AI scoring for all unscored leads in a job, or a specific set of lead IDs. Runs in background — returns immediately with count. Consumes AI credits.

tools.name: list_lead_lists
tools.description: List Hunter.io lead lists associated with the account.

tools.name: create_lead_list
tools.description: Create a new Hunter.io lead list.

tools.name: sync_lead_list
tools.description: Sync a Hunter.io lead list into local lead records.

tools.name: preview_message
tools.description: Generate a sample AI-personalised outreach message for a person. Public endpoint — no auth required.

tools.name: send_to_campaign
tools.description: Bulk-import selected lead IDs into a campaign's contact list. Leads must belong to the authenticated user.

tools.name: list_deals
tools.description: List deals with optional status filter. Returns deals array plus revenue summary (total, closed, pipeline).

tools.name: create_deal
tools.description: Create a new deal linked to a lead email.

tools.name: update_deal
tools.description: Update a deal's status, value, or notes.

tools.name: get_pipeline
tools.description: Get the full sales pipeline board with deals grouped by stage (new, contacted, interested, meeting, proposal, closed, lost) plus revenue totals.

tools.name: move_deal_stage
tools.description: Move a deal to a new pipeline stage (drag-and-drop equivalent).

tools.name: start_autopilot
tools.description: Start an AI autopilot run for outreach automation. Provide a goal and the agent runs fire-and-forget. Returns runId — poll get_autopilot_status for progress. Consumes autopilot credits.

tools.name: list_autopilot_runs
tools.description: List past autopilot runs with their status and summary results.

tools.name: get_autopilot_status
tools.description: Get the current status and progress of a specific autopilot run.

tools.name: get_channels_status
tools.description: Get the status, configuration, and delivery stats for all outreach channels (WhatsApp, SMS, push notifications).

tools.name: update_channel
tools.description: Enable or disable a specific outreach channel (whatsapp, sms, or push).

tools.name: get_sales_agent_config
tools.description: Fetch the current user's AI sales agent configuration.

tools.name: update_sales_agent_config
tools.description: Update the AI sales agent configuration (enable/disable, cal link, offer price, reply limits, confidence threshold).

tools.name: get_sales_agent_actions
tools.description: Fetch today's AI sales agent actions and summary stats (total actions, deals closed, flagged for human review).

tools.name: process_sales_agent
tools.description: Run the AI sales agent pipeline on a conversation — decides the next action and optionally generates a reply. Logs the action to the agent activity feed.

prompts.name: build_lead_list
prompts.description: Find, enrich, verify and score a target lead list before any outreach.

arguments.name: icp
arguments.description: Ideal customer profile — industry, size, geography, role

prompts.name: outreach_sequence
prompts.description: Design and preview a multi-channel sequence, sending only after approval.

prompts.name: pipeline_review
prompts.description: Review deal pipeline health and recommend the next actions.

prompts.name: autopilot_audit
prompts.description: Check what autopilot has been doing and whether it should keep running.

prompts.name: sales_agent_tuning
prompts.description: Review the AI sales agent's configuration and recent actions.

resources.name: Connected channels
resources.description: Which outreach channels are connected and healthy. Read this before designing any sequence — a step on a disconnected channel silently never sends.

resources.name: Lead lists
resources.description: Your saved lead lists with sizes, so a campaign targets a real audience.

resources.name: Deal pipeline
resources.description: Current pipeline by stage — the baseline for any performance question.

resources.name: Autopilot status
resources.description: Whether autopilot is running, and its current sending posture.
